github.body:
V3.1 shared account, execution and evidence runtime
## Purpose

V3.1 combines spot trend, spot grid and futures trend in one shared account. This PR has four parts:
- **The runtime.** Shared accounting, risk controls, decision evidence, and the full multi-asset strategy replay in both modeled scenarios.
- **Baseline adapters.** The frozen V0-V3 basel

hackernews.author: psxuaw
hackernews.body:
Self-hosted infrastructure with Incus OS
IncusOS is amazing. Since K8s envelopes my day job, I rarely get to test out things like this. If cloud on-prem continues taking off the way it has in the last year, this sort of deployment will be ideal.
Also, I loathe Proxmox. With Proxmox, you are one bad upgrade away from disaster at every turn. Thank you for this writeup, I think your setup deserves another writeup, but form the sre/gitops perspective.  I've been thinking about building something similar, but using the lighthouse patter.  One git repository on GitHub or gitea to prop up origin-vps(forgejo+harbor+warpgate+headscale), which ... I've used Incus, but not Incus OS. Sounds pretty appealing though - immutable OS, A/B updates & very locked down.

comment_insights: Thank you for this writeup, I think your setup deserves another writeup, but form the sre/gitops perspective
I've used Incus, but not Incus OS
The name “data swamp” just absolutely got me
Seems like a very sophisticated setup.
